policies.title: Spending approval threshold
policies.text: Any purchase with a total above PKR 75,000 must be approved through the approval process before an order is placed. Purchases of exactly PKR 75,000 or less do not need approval.

policies.title: Approved vendor list
policies.text: Only suppliers on the approved vendor list (Shisham Timber Depot, Khyber Office Mart) may be ordered from directly. Any order from a supplier that is not on the approved vendor list must be approved through the approval process.
